## Checklist

- [ ] Frontmatter is complete and `updated:` is bumped
- [ ] `status:` is correct — remember `draft` and `inbox` are not published
- [ ] Internal links are relative Markdown links with `.md`, and they resolve
- [ ] Any new concept is listed in [`03-Concepts/README.md`](../03-Concepts/README.md)
- [ ] Mermaid diagrams render in **both** Obsidian and `mkdocs serve`
- [ ] `mkdocs build --strict` passes locally
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, tokens or private URLs
- [ ] No course solution code (6.5840 and Coursera both ask that it stays unpublished)

## For a concept note

- [ ] **My Understanding** is written from memory, with sources closed
- [ ] Failure scenarios are covered
- [ ] Related concepts link in both directions

## For a lab

- [ ] **Expected Result** was written before running
- [ ] **Actual Result** is filled in
- [ ] The prediction is explicitly judged right or wrong
